name: Current experience baseline
summary: Before a redesign, the design lead gets a baseline built from the captures and page list they supply: each page read with its content and design observations, the patterns that recur, and the pages outside the evidence. The lead confirms the baseline and sets the scope.

sources.title: FullyPowered AI's own published map of design and user experience work, and its own method for turning supplied captures and a page list into a baseline of a current site.
